description: LUTGPT narrow-backbone reference config (matches exp755 of the published report). E=192 (rank-coded backbone), D=384 (Euclidean D-stream accumulator), H=6, d_qk=64, d_v=32, L=6. Single-phase hybrid_smooth forward for all 16K steps; bf16 LUT storage with fp32 master Lion state; clip_grad_norm 1.0; AdamW (3e-4) for non-LUT params, Lion (2e-4) for LUT weights. Effective batch = 48 * 512 = 24576 tokens per step (device_batch_size=24, grad_accum=2 for memory on a single GPU).
